verifier_note: Every url re-opened with the kit's fetcher on 2026-10-03; each fact was found on its page as recorded and each candidate is tied to the race by the county or city and the office or district. One correction: Witt's office 'from' was 1999, a year the page does not state (it says she won election in 1998); set to null, with 'first elected 1998' kept in the office wording.
note: 30 candidates in this part. The session's shared web-search allowance was already used up when this part began, so no search was run: pages were read only from known official addresses and from the links on party pages already listed in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json, with the kit's own fetcher (states/net.py). Campaign sites were found for Johnson (linked from the Madison County Democratic Party's Vote page), Edwards (same page) and Witt (linked from the Fayette County Democratic Party's 2026 Action Center). Party listings that do not say endorsed are already in ky_endorsements.json and are not repeated here as endorsements. Checked and not found: Hopkinsville's council page (Ward 8 is held by another member, so Crisp is not an incumbent), Richmond's commission page (Edwards is not a sitting commissioner), Marion County's magistrates (District 3 is held by his opponent, so nothing for Larry Smith), Logan County District 6 (held by his opponent, Thomas Bouldin), Woodford District 4 (held by her opponent, Kelly Carl), Simpson County's fiscal court (West District held by Jeffery Burr), Henry County's officials (the PVA listed is Jason Scriber), Kenton County's constables (Turner not listed), Hardin County's directory (no surveyor listed). Sites that did not resolve or answered nothing usable: Lyndon, Bourbon County and Bourbon schools' board page (no names in the page text), Green County schools (self-signed certificate), Pendleton and Mercer county officials pages (names not in the page text), Crittenden County, Garrard County (certificate for another host). McPherson is a sitting legislator with a record page; no campaign site was found for him. Nothing could be read for the constables, Reik, Downey, Huddleston, Chad Duke, Popham, Marshel Davis, Ott, Crebessa, Strong, Allison Cox, Nelson or Buchanan, so they are left out.
